_what_this_is: Slugs of episodes already published, newest last. research/publish_order.py reads this to expire entries from the owner-pinned head and to drop published episodes from the queue.
_who_writes_it: The loop, or the owner, after an upload succeeds. Nothing in research/ writes to it.
_contract: published: array of script slugs, e.g. "14-how-big-is-a-colossal-squid". Unknown slugs are reported, not ignored.
